analysis.title: 13Fs - Q3 2026
key_insights: Roberts & Ryan NYSE Sales & Trading compiles Q3 2026 13F filings for about 35 filers, each compared with Q2 2026. All share counts are described as approximate. The note lists new, increased, maintained, exited and decreased positions per filer and gives no views or ratings.

Berkshire Hathaway raised Lennar (LEN) to 26.03 mln shares from 13.11 mln and Delta (DAL) to 64.45 mln from 57.32 mln. It cut Bank of America (BAC) to 455.86 mln from 483.39 mln, Kroger (KR) to 35 mln from 39 mln and Capital One (COF) to 1.15 mln from 3 mln. It held its Apple, Coca-Cola, Occidental and Chevron stakes unchanged.
Berkshire's position in GOOGL stayed at 78.79 mln shares and its GOOG position at 27.19 mln.

Appaloosa (Tepper) added SPCX to 3.88 mln shares from 225K and NVDA to 2 mln from 1.53 mln. It also added MU, LRCX, CRWV and ASML. It opened PCG, ORCL, MOD and AMAT and exited QCOM, AMD, AVGO, GT and WHR. It cut AAL to 3.93 mln from 7.5 mln, GOOG to 1 mln from 1.85 mln and META to 525K from 675K.

SPCX appears across several filers. Appaloosa, Third Point (980K from 180K) and Duquesne (new, 202K) bought it, and NVIDIA's own 13F raised it to 130.47 mln from 122.76 mln. D1 trimmed to 116.75 mln from 126.04 mln, Altimeter cut to 1.06 mln from 1.78 mln, and Tiger held 375K.

NVIDIA's own 13F shows it cut NOK to 72.86 mln from 166.39 mln and INTC to 161.08 mln from 214.78 mln. It held CRWV (47.21 mln), COHR (7.79 mln) and NBIS (1.19 mln) and trimmed SNPS to 4.35 mln from 4.82 mln.

Intel (INTC) stock was bought by several funds. Soros Fund went to 2.83 mln shares from 100K, Tiger to 5.54 mln from 4.25 mln, and Discovery opened 173K. Lone Pine opened 5.99 mln. Intel's own 13F opened IREN (1.29 mln) and held MBLY and JOBY.

NU (Nubank) was added by Soros Capital (146K from 125K), Senator (3.95 mln from 3.23 mln), D1 (50.97 mln from 44.42 mln) and Discovery (5.25 mln from 3.59 mln, also holds calls). Lone Pine (47.52 mln) and Tiger (11.03 mln) maintained it, and SoftBank trimmed to 16.83 mln from 17.84 mln.

NVDA was added by Senator (444K from 337K), Altimeter (10.01 mln from 9.41 mln), Tiger (12 mln from 11.2 mln), Appaloosa and Corvex (maintained 16K), and opened new by Third Point (1.5 mln). It was cut by Soros Capital (10K from 77K), Soros Fund (859K from 1.06 mln) and Duquesne, which did not list it.

TSM was cut by Soros Capital (28K from 78K), Duquesne (33K from 590K), Tiger (3.13 mln from 4.88 mln), Third Point, Lansdowne, Appaloosa and Senator. It was increased by Lone Pine (1.72 mln from 101K), Viking (3.9 mln from 3.17 mln) and Soros Fund (549K from 522K).

META was bought by Soros Capital (43K from 3K), Altimeter (1.7 mln from 1.35 mln), Soros Fund (152K from 22K), Lone Pine (new, 1.25 mln) and Third Point (new, 655K). It was reduced by Viking (923K from 1.87 mln), Tiger, Pershing, Appaloosa and Miller, and D1 exited its 567K shares.

GOOGL and GOOG saw mixed flows. Soros Capital opened GOOGL (29K), Viking opened 1.73 mln and Lone Pine increased to 2.16 mln from 216K. D1, Duquesne and Altimeter exited GOOGL, Third Point cut to 175K from 1.03 mln, Tiger cut to 3.35 mln from 5.81 mln, and Baupost cut GOOG to 950K from 1.37 mln.

Amazon (AMZN) activity was mixed. Lone Pine opened 5.6 mln shares and Discovery raised to 457K from 176K. Duquesne raised to 773K from 542K (also holds calls) and D1 raised to 1 mln from 628K. Third Point exited 1.75 mln, Viking cut to 2.92 mln from 3.7 mln and Appaloosa cut to 4.48 mln from 5 mln. Baupost, Pershing and Omega held their stakes.

Crypto-miner and AI-hosting names saw active repositioning. Viking opened WULF (14.42 mln), APLD (10.53 mln) and CIFR (2.03 mln). Lone Pine opened CIFR (10.46 mln) and cut WULF to 10.54 mln from 24.14 mln. Tiger exited CIFR, APLD and CORZ. Soros Capital cut WULF to 22K from 762K, and Glenview opened CORZ (1.59 mln).

Soros Fund opened about 50 new positions, the largest new-position count in the note. The biggest were CCO (8.8 mln shares), ACVA (3.69 mln), AES (3.63 mln), OGN (2.95 mln) and JBLU (1.65 mln). It also exited about 50 names, including DBRG (4.12 mln) and GBTG (3.35 mln).
Soros Capital (Robert Soros) opened GOOGL, SEI, TMO and MSFT and exited about 22 names, including PUMP (1.44 mln shares), ON, ARHS, NBIS, AMAT, NKE and CAT.

Pershing Square opened PS (184.29 mln shares), ALC (14.74 mln) and ICE (6.64 mln) and added to NFLX (15.41 mln from 13.08 mln). It cut MSFT to 4.06 mln from 6.21 mln and BN to 51.33 mln from 57.48 mln, and exited HTZ.

Viking Global opened RKT (24.66 mln shares), TSCO (16.34 mln), WULF and APLD and raised AZUL to 6.92 mln from 1.35 mln and TSLA to 2.34 mln from 548K. It exited CCL, SCHW, BCE, AS, GM, IBKR, MSFT and about 30 other names.
TSLA was bought by Altimeter (new, 1.92 mln shares), Viking (2.34 mln from 548K) and D1 (512K from 402K). AZUL was added by Senator (1.62 mln from 506K) and Viking (6.92 mln from 1.35 mln).
Icahn raised IEP to 658.92 mln shares from 618.39 mln. It exited JBLU (20.66 mln) and AEP and cut IFF to 2.99 mln from 4.28 mln. Soros Fund opened a 1.65 mln-share JBLU position.

Activist filers added to existing campaigns. Jana added FUN, FISV and COO, Engaged added VFC, YETI and CGNX, and Starboard added IJH, FLS and RIOT and opened KNF and SHAK. Trian opened RTO and exited JHG (25.65 mln shares). Baupost opened SITE and HONA and doubled AXTA to 2.51 mln from 1.27 mln.

Thiel Macro opened SOXX (283K shares) and MSFT (2K), raised VIST and exited FE, CMS, AEP, DTE and XE. SoftBank exited SATL and trimmed NU, VTEX, LIFE and ABCL. Alibaba (BABA) trimmed XPEV to 30.13 mln from 33.54 mln.

The document is an email distribution from Roberts & Ryan with a standard institutional-use disclaimer. Some entries repeat in the text, and some share counts are abbreviated. The note gives no prices, valuations or ratings.
crypto_views: Several filers held or traded crypto-linked equities in Q3 2026. Viking opened WULF, APLD and CIFR, Lone Pine opened CIFR and Tiger exited CIFR, APLD and CORZ. Altimeter, Tiger and Duquesne (RIOT 906K from 755K) held crypto-linked stocks. Third Point opened RIOT (922K) and Starboard raised RIOT to 10.5 mln from 10.11 mln. Discovery opened BTDR (978K) while Lone Pine exited BTDR (7.02 mln). Soros Fund raised GLXY to 992K from 204K. Miller raised MSTR to 61K from 50K.
vol_and_positioning: Q3 2026 13F position changes for about 35 hedge funds and corporates, as compared with Q2 2026. Several filers report call positions alongside shares: Soros Fund in XLU (835K shares plus calls), RUN, VRNS, ITRI and PONY, Duquesne in AMZN, STX, INSM and CDW, Glenview in META and NU at Discovery. Soros Fund and Corvex META calls no longer held (Corvex), HUN calls no longer held (Soros Fund) and Duquesne RSP calls no longer held.
